correctness.rationale: An exact eigenvalue reduction gives the roots of a positive definite 2-by-2 coupled block and the untouched eigenvalue c. The coupled spectral ratio uniquely minimizes at theta=b by AM-GM; the lower root is strictly monotone, and comparison of its unique crossing of c with b gives the exhaustive two-branch unique global minimizer. Strict boundary hypotheses and the t=0 exception are explicit. The extracted reproducibility script passed 255 exact-fraction identities and 4,032 independently evaluated numerical comparisons; continuum validity relies on proof.

value.rationale: Three modes are the minimal natural setting for one recycled spectral direction with two untouched eigenvalues competing as a condition-number floor. The exact all-theta optimizer and sharp coupling transition quantify where a fixed-gap perturbation theory excludes optimal scaling and when the optimum necessarily equals an untouched eigenvalue. This is a structural parameter-selection benchmark with a motivated mathematical role, not an arbitrary scalar computation or claim of a general CG iteration theorem.
